interfaces.name: flight_state
interfaces.description: Output container declared by the current public task contract.
interfaces.range_or_shape: Log four complete-run MATLAB Timeseries named flight_state, air_data, actuation, and force_moment. flight_state has 15 channels in this order: north, east, altitude (m); north, east, and down inertial velocity (m/s); true airspeed (m/s); angle of attack, sideslip, roll, pitch, and yaw (rad); and body p, q, and r (rad/s).

interfaces.name: air_data
interfaces.description: Output container declared by the current public task contract.
interfaces.range_or_shape: Compute relative air velocity as ground velocity minus this gust vector before transforming it into body axes; air_data must log this same applied NED vector. Log four complete-run MATLAB Timeseries named flight_state, air_data, actuation, and force_moment. air_data has 6 channels in this order: air density (kg/m^3), dynamic pressure (Pa), Mach number (1), and applied gust north, east, and down (m/s).

interfaces.name: actuation
interfaces.description: Output container declared by the current public task contract.
interfaces.range_or_shape: Log four complete-run MATLAB Timeseries named flight_state, air_data, actuation, and force_moment. actuation has 10 channels in this order: commanded thrust (N), commanded elevator, aileron, rudder, and leading-edge flap (rad), followed by the corresponding five actual actuator outputs in the same units.

interfaces.name: force_moment
interfaces.description: Output container declared by the current public task contract.
interfaces.range_or_shape: Log four complete-run MATLAB Timeseries named flight_state, air_data, actuation, and force_moment. force_moment has 12 channels in this order: aerodynamic body force xyz (N), aerodynamic body moment xyz (N*m), total body force xyz including thrust and gravity (N), and total body moment xyz (N*m).

signs_and_coordinates: Use a north-east-down inertial frame, report altitude as minus inertial down position, and use standard body axes x forward, y right, z down.
Attitude is the 3-2-1 yaw-pitch-roll orientation from body to inertial coordinates;
feedback_and_control_causality: its internal coordinates and control design are not prescribed, but forces and moments must vary causally with dynamic pressure, angle of attack, sideslip, rates and actual surface deflections.
